<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <g aria-label="status bar">
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="21" x2="318" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="18" x2="323" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="15" x2="328" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="22" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="27" x2="348" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="359" y="16" width="21" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="361.5" y="18.5" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="380.5" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="IMDb header">
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="60" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <polyline points="31,74 24,80 31,86" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="83" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">IMDb</text>
    <text x="368" y="81" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Sign up</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="registration content">
    <text x="24" y="137" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Create your account</text>
    <text x="24" y="160" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Join IMDb to rate movies and save your favorites.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="25" y="176" width="340" height="46" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
      <rect x="24" y="175" width="340" height="46" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="52" cy="198" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="52" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#477FFF">G</text>
      <text x="195" y="203" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Continue with Google</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="25" y="232" width="340" height="46" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
      <rect x="24" y="231" width="340" height="46" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
      <circle cx="52" cy="254" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="52" y="259" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#477FFF">f</text>
      <text x="195" y="259" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue with Facebook</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="24" y1="299" x2="170" y2="299" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="299" x2="366" y2="299" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="303" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">or sign up with email</text>

    <text x="24" y="326" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="333" width="342" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="359" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">movie_fan_24</text>

    <text x="24" y="399" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
    <rect x="24" y="406" width="342" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="432" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">name@example.com</text>

    <text x="24" y="472" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="479" width="342" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="505" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Enter password</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="497" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="503" x2="353" y2="491" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="24" y="545" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="552" width="342" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="578" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Re-enter password</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="570" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="576" x2="353" y2="564" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <rect x="24" y="615" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="28,624 32,628 39,620" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="629" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Remember me</text>
    <text x="366" y="629" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Keep me signed in</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="25" y="665" width="340" height="48" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
      <rect x="24" y="664" width="340" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
      <text x="194" y="694" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Create account</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="738" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By creating an account, you agree to IMDb's terms.</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="bottom navigation">
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="42,795 51,788 60,795 60,805 43,805" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="40,795 51,786 62,795" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="51" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="145" cy="797" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="151" y1="803" x2="157" y2="809" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="145" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <polyline points="233,790 239,788 245,790 249,797 239,807 229,797 233,790" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="239" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="335" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="335" cy="805" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="335" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#F2C94C">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
